name: agentchattr-autonomy-queue

root_marker.note: every command refuses roots whose marker is missing, unreadable, non-regular, has extra/missing keys, or non-exact types

cli.stdout: exactly one JSON object per invocation, success and failure alike; nothing else is printed

exit_codes.2: validation error or transition conflict (fail-closed refusal); includes claim finding no eligible work
exit_codes.3: AUDIT_GAP reported by audit, or unrecoverable I/O failure

claim_no_eligible_work.note: an empty poll is deliberately a non-success exit so schedulers cannot mistake it for a claim

commands.claim-exact: --root R claim-exact --task-id T --expected-next-attempt N --expected-digest D --profile P --model M --worker W
commands.complete-exact: --root R complete-exact --task-id T --expected-attempt N --expected-digest D --worker W
commands.fail-exact: --root R fail-exact --task-id T --expected-attempt N --expected-digest D --worker W --disposition retry|final [--reason TEXT]
commands.block-exact: --root R block-exact --task-id T --expected-attempt N --expected-digest D --worker W --reason TEXT
commands.requeue-exact: --root R requeue-exact --task-id T --expected-attempt N --expected-digest D --worker W

invariant: exactly one of the five state directories contains <task_id>.json for every known task; audit reports duplicate or missing state as AUDIT_GAP

durable_layout.exact_protocol: exact/<task_id>.json is an immutable per-task protocol marker published before the first exact state mutation; its prior_event_seq binds the marker-free legacy prefix and exact protocol governs the contiguous tail
durable_layout.events: events/<task_id>/<seq:06d>.json is the append-only transition chain
durable_layout.attempts: attempts/<task_id>/a<N>/ is the immutable claim-attempt index

claim.actor: worker; a queued card with attempt >= max_attempts is refused without durable mutation: legacy claim refuses max-attempts-exhausted, while exact verbs refuse it during semantic validation as exact-evidence-invalid (audit reports attempt_budget_violation)
claim.attempt_semantics: event.attempt = incremented attempt; the increment may never exceed max_attempts

fail-retry.actor: supervisor via CLI fail; chosen when attempt < max_attempts

fail-final.actor: supervisor via CLI fail; chosen when attempt >= max_attempts

block-malformed.actor: claim quarantine of an unreadable/invalid card; event.attempt recorded as 0 because the card cannot be read and is not replay-checked

block-payload.actor: claim quarantine when payload containment/sha256 verification fails

block-attempt-dir.actor: claim quarantine when attempts/<task>/a<N> already exists or its path is unsafe

requeue-blocked.actor: operator; marker-free tasks only; only while attempt < max_attempts; preserves attempt

requeue-failed.actor: operator; marker-free tasks only; only while attempt < max_attempts; preserves attempt

requeue-exact.actor: operator/worker owning the exact blocked tail via CLI requeue-exact; only while attempt < max_attempts and the payload re-verifies byte-exactly; preserves attempt. The tail must be a terminal block or an exact block-payload quarantine: a block-attempt-dir tail refuses exact-attempt-dir-not-requeueable for every worker because its immutable collision directory cannot be removed or reused (recovery is a new task_id)
requeue-exact.attempt_semantics: unchanged; the exact event binds attempt_dir a<attempt+1>, the re-armed next generation that the subsequent exact claim creates

task_id.note: Windows reserved device names (con, prn, aux, nul, com1-9, lpt1-9) additionally rejected

allowed_root.constraint: absolute path, <=1024 chars, no NUL; claimant refuses payloads outside it

restart_safe.note: absent key is treated as false by readers; int 0/1 rejected

attempt.note: must be exactly 0 at enqueue; incremented durably by claim; preserved by requeue

max_attempts.note: ONLY exact int 1 or 2; bool true/false, floats (2.0), strings, 0, and values > 2 are all rejected

created_utc.note: regex plus real calendar validation (month 13 etc. rejected)

payload_relpath.constraint: relative to allowed_root; <=1024 chars; rejects absolute paths, empty/./.. segments, control chars, <>:"|?* (which also blocks drive letters and NTFS alternate data streams), and Windows reserved device-name segments

payload_sha256.note: uppercase hex SHA-256 of the payload bytes; payload text never lives in the card

exact_cas.authority_digest: lowercase SHA-256 of canonical sort-key compact ASCII JSON without a trailing newline for the normalized task card after defaults are materialized, excluding only the mutable attempt field
exact_cas.generation: current attempt and expected next attempt are separate integers; the digest deliberately stays stable across an attempt bump
exact_cas.peek: peek-exact returns one task-locked, semantically validated authority view for a task in any single durable state; worker is the exact durable claim owner for in_progress and null in every other state; corrupt history/attempt/marker evidence refuses instead of returning a view; executable states (queue, in_progress) keep the strict payload gate and refuse an unverifiable payload, while non-executable states (blocked/done/failed) report the payload verification outcome inside the view (verified:false plus the refusal code) so a quarantined card stays inspectable; it performs no queue-evidence mutation and contains no nonce
exact_cas.list: list-exact returns sorted individually task-locked, semantically validated queue views with worker=null; any malformed queue entry or corrupt task evidence still fails the whole list closed (all-or-nothing head-of-line refusal, retained so dispatch cannot silently skip corrupt queued work). A payload-only verification failure on an otherwise semantically valid queue card does NOT abort the list: that entry is exposed deterministically with payload verified:false, error code, and path null, so one drifted payload cannot hide healthy tasks; each view is a claim input, not a globally atomic snapshot; it performs no queue-evidence mutation and contains no nonce
exact_cas.claim: claim-exact accepts task_id + exact next attempt + authority digest + profile + model + worker; all are checked with state, budget, and payload under the per-task lock before the move
exact_cas.payload_quarantine: audit reports exact_payload_unavailable with task_id, the durable authority digest, and next_attempt when an otherwise-valid queued card (marker-governed or still marker-free) has a missing/drifted payload. The digest is the immutable marker authority when a marker exists, otherwise the authority digest of the validated queue card written at enqueue. quarantine-exact-payload accepts only task_id + worker, derives digest and generation solely from that durable evidence, verifies that the current payload is unavailable, and publishes canonical exact block-payload evidence; for a marker-free queued card it first publishes the exact protocol marker (first_exact_attempt = attempt+1) under the same lock strictly before the state move, so a crash between the two leaves the admitted idempotent response-loss window. It never guesses authority from current payload bytes or a caller-supplied digest. A healthy marker-free card refuses exact-payload-not-drifted before any marker is published. An identical retry after response loss accepts only the matching canonical blocked tail and does not reread the payload; a marker-free non-queue card refuses exact-evidence-missing and stays on legacy verbs
exact_cas.corrupt_history_policy: quarantine-exact-payload is task-targeted, so unrelated corrupt queue history does not prevent quarantining the named valid task. Corruption in the named task refuses without mutation, audit remains non-clean, and audit never labels the corrupt task exact_payload_unavailable. list-exact deliberately remains all-or-nothing fail-closed while any corrupt queued history is unresolved; only payload-only drift is exposed per-entry instead
exact_cas.requeue: requeue-exact accepts task_id + exact current attempt + authority digest + worker and moves blocked -> queue while attempt < max_attempts. Authority and ownership are the durable exact blocked tail (terminal block or exact block-payload quarantine): the caller worker must equal that tail's worker and the digest must match the marker/card authority. A block-attempt-dir tail is never requeueable: its immutable collision directory a<attempt+1> cannot be removed or reused, so a re-armed claim would collide and quarantine again forever; it refuses exact-attempt-dir-not-requeueable before any mutation for every worker and the safe recovery is a new task_id. The payload must re-verify byte-exactly first; a still-drifted payload refuses exact-payload-not-restored without mutation. The published exact event preserves attempt and binds attempt_dir a<attempt+1> in move-then-event order, so a crash between the two stays a visible AUDIT_GAP that is never repaired. An identical retry after response loss accepts only the matching canonical requeue-exact queue tail and refuses every other worker; owner continuity is durable, not response-local: semantic validation and audit require every persisted requeue-exact event worker to equal the worker on its immediately preceding exact blocked tail, so an event-only worker rewrite fails closed (exact-evidence-invalid; audit exact_transition_inconsistency) instead of transferring ownership. Exhausted budget refuses max-attempts-exhausted; a marker-free blocked task refuses exact-evidence-missing and stays on legacy requeue; failed is unreachable because exact fail-final only happens with the budget exhausted

closed_schema.prior_event_seq: exact int 0..999999 equal to the contiguous event count immediately before marker publication

protocol_marker.canonical_bytes: the marker must be the exact canonical compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON encoding emitted by the queue; alternate ordering/whitespace, duplicate keys, malformed bytes, missing/extra keys, and non-exact types refuse
protocol_marker.publication: published with exclusive no-overwrite create while holding the task lock, after exact admission checks and before the first exact state move; prior_event_seq is captured from the already-validated contiguous chain under that lock; an existing matching marker is the only permitted response-loss replay
protocol_marker.binding: the immutable marker binds task_id, authority digest, first exact attempt, and the exact tail boundary independently of mutable event fields. Events at or before prior_event_seq are supported marker-free legacy history and must replay to queue at attempt first_exact_attempt-1; events after it are exact-governed. Exact metadata before/at the boundary, or omitted from a governed exact claim/pre-claim quarantine, is inconsistent
protocol_marker.response_loss_window: marker plus the unchanged queue state at attempt first_exact_attempt-1 is the valid no-event window; retry continues idempotently. At the same boundary, exact block-payload or block-attempt-dir is a canonical terminal quarantine. A conflicting durable marker is invalid semantic evidence; a conflict observed during exclusive marker publication refuses exact-protocol-conflict
protocol_marker.immutability_limit: the threat model detects event-only or card-only downgrade/tampering; a same-identity writer coherently replacing the marker, card, complete event chain, and attempt tree is outside this filesystem integrity model

exact_cas.semantic_admission: before every exact mutation or replay and every authoritative exact read, one per-task validator under the existing task lock replays the full contiguous event chain and verifies legal from/to transitions, attempts, fail/requeue budget policy, current card state+attempt+authority, marker boundary/prefix consistency, first_exact_attempt <= max_attempts, exact ownership, and an exact complete attempt-directory index including a canonical exact collision directory; a requeue-exact event must be marker-governed, after the boundary, carry exact metadata, respect the budget, immediately follow an exact terminal block or exact block-payload tail (never block-attempt-dir), and carry exactly that predecessor's worker; any missing, malformed, extra, or inconsistent evidence refuses without repair
exact_cas.claim_replay: an identical call succeeds in already-in_progress only when the current card, exact claim event, immutable attempt dir, payload, attempt, digest, profile, model, and worker all match
exact_cas.terminal: complete-exact/fail-exact/block-exact require the exact attempt, digest, and worker owning the last exact claim; fail additionally requires a retry/final disposition equal to the card policy before mutation
exact_cas.terminal_replay: an identical already-terminal transition succeeds only when the current card and tail exact event match and the fail disposition is recomputed from the current validated card; a conflicting transition, worker, attempt, digest, disposition, reason, or non-tail event refuses
exact_cas.shared_refusals: root, card-schema, payload, worker/filter, invalid-arguments, and I/O errors retain the existing stable queue codes
exact_cas.legacy_guard: legacy claim, complete, fail, block, and requeue run under the task lock and use full semantic validation whenever history evidence exists; malformed/incomplete evidence refuses exact-evidence-invalid. A marker may be admitted after valid marker-free legacy quarantine/requeue history, which remains a historical prefix and is not retroactively reinterpreted. Once the independent exact marker exists, every new legacy mutation refuses exact-transition-required even if exact fields were stripped from events or a worker field was rewritten
exact_cas.nonce: no queue card, queue view, or queue event contains a nonce; any future dispatch nonce belongs to tick_state intent

checks: allowed_root resolves to an existing real directory
every relpath component is lstat-checked: any symlink, junction, or other reparse point anywhere on the walk is rejected
final component must be a regular file
size <= max_bytes before and during the bounded hash read
SHA-256 of the full content must equal payload_sha256 exactly
payload_verification.on_failure_at_claim: legacy claim quarantines queue -> blocked with a base block-payload event. If an exact marker already governs the queued card, claim-exact instead publishes canonical exact block-payload evidence (authority_digest plus the attempted next attempt_dir), including after a prior response was lost; it never leaves a clean but permanently unclaimable exact queue card. claim-exact on a still marker-free drifted card refuses without quarantining; the targeted quarantine command is the exact-protocol repair path for that case
payload_verification.restart_recovery: audit re-verifies the payload of every otherwise-valid queued card -- marker-governed or still marker-free -- and reports exact_payload_unavailable instead of clean, carrying the durable authority digest (marker when present, otherwise the enqueue-validated card) and the next attempt. quarantine-exact-payload then performs the canonical quarantine using only that durable evidence, publishing the exact marker first for a marker-free card; a healthy payload refuses exact-payload-not-drifted. After quarantine the payload can be restored and the task re-armed with requeue-exact while budget remains

atomicity.task_transaction: every state-changing command holds a per-task cross-process OS file lock from its first authoritative read through state move, attempt mutation, and event publication; OS crash-release never repairs files, so a move/event crash remains an AUDIT_GAP
atomicity.exact_protocol_publish: the immutable exact/<task_id>.json marker is exclusively published under the same task lock before the first exact state move and records the exact pre-marker event boundary; a lost response before that move is an admitted idempotent retry window
atomicity.state_transition: single same-volume NO-OVERWRITE atomic rename of <task_id>.json between state directories (Windows os.rename refuses existing targets; POSIX uses link+unlink). The losing racer gets a filesystem error, never a duplicate claim, and an existing target card is never replaced.
atomicity.card_rewrite: temp file under <root>/tmp + os.replace, only for the owned in_progress attempt bump
atomicity.event_publish: temp file under <root>/tmp + exclusive no-overwrite rename/link into events/<task_id>/; an existing seq file can never be replaced; collisions rescan and retry, then fail closed
atomicity.path_guard: every state/events/attempts path component is validated against a closed name grammar and lstat-checked for symlink/junction/reparse points before any read or write

events.layout: events/<task_id>/<seq:06d>.json, append-only, one file per seq
events.seq: per-task, contiguous from 1; derived as max(existing)+1, never len()+1; published with exclusive create so an existing seq cannot be overwritten
events.closed_schema: one of two closed shapes: base keys, or base keys plus both exact authority_digest and attempt_dir. The exact pair is valid on claim/complete/fail-retry/fail-final/block, on exact pre-claim block-payload/block-attempt-dir, and on requeue-exact (where it is mandatory); it is rejected on block-malformed and the legacy requeue transitions

seq.note: must equal both its position in the chain and its file name

from_state.constraint: must equal the transition table entry

to_state.constraint: must equal the transition table entry

authority_digest.optional_pair: present together with attempt_dir on exact claim/terminal evidence, exact block-payload/block-attempt-dir, and requeue-exact; forbidden on block-malformed and legacy requeue events

attempt_dir.constraint: when present on claim/terminal evidence, exactly a<event.attempt>; on exact block-payload/block-attempt-dir and requeue-exact, exactly a<event.attempt+1>; present together with authority_digest

events.ordering: published strictly AFTER the state transition while the same per-task OS lock remains held; a crash between the two releases the lock and leaves a visible AUDIT_GAP, never silently repaired

attempt_dirs.creation: exclusive os.mkdir during claim, after payload re-verify and before the card attempt bump; a pre-existing directory a<N> fails exact claim closed with rollback plus canonical exact block-attempt-dir whose bound collision directory remains expected immutable evidence; that quarantine is terminal for the task identity (requeue-exact refuses exact-attempt-dir-not-requeueable); an unsafe/non-directory collision is an unrecoverable I/O divergence
attempt_dirs.immutability: attempt dirs are never reused and never renumbered; a permitted requeue preserves attempt so the next claim creates a fresh a<N+1>; requeue is refused once attempt >= max_attempts

order: verify payload (legacy bad -> base block-payload quarantine; bad on an already exact-managed queued card -> canonical exact block-payload quarantine)
for claim-exact: exclusively publish or verify exact/<task_id>.json before the first exact state mutation
atomic no-overwrite rename queue -> in_progress (single winner)
exclusive mkdir attempts/<task>/a<N> (exists -> rollback + block-attempt-dir quarantine)
print success JSON (the ONLY signal that a claim is executable)

documented_windows.crash_after_rename_before_card_rewrite: in_progress card with stale attempt and no claim event -> audit state_mismatch (or attempt_without_events)
documented_windows.crash_after_card_rewrite_before_event: card attempt ahead of claim events -> audit card_attempt_mismatch
documented_windows.posix_link_unlink_window: card visible in two state dirs -> audit duplicate_states

audit.semantics: discovers task identities, acquires their per-task locks in sorted order, retries discovery until it has one stable locked snapshot, then replays every event chain from (queue, attempt=0) and independently compares the replayed truth against the exactly-one state card, its attempt field, immutable exact marker and its legacy-prefix boundary, and immutable attempt dirs; it verifies first_exact_attempt <= max_attempts, serializes with queue mutations, and never repairs evidence
audit.exit: 3 with {"audit": "AUDIT_GAP"} when any gap exists, 0 when clean
audit.malformed_card_exception: an unreadable card in blocked/ whose final event is block-malformed is a KNOWN quarantined state, not a gap

fail_policy: CLI fail is the single supervisor retry path from in_progress: back to queue while attempt < max_attempts (fail-retry), else to failed (fail-final); with the default max_attempts=2 the second failure is final. Legacy requeue is the operator path only while the task is still marker-free, may precede later exact admission, requires attempt < max_attempts, and preserves attempt. Exact-marked tasks must stay on exact verbs and cannot append a legacy requeue; requeue-exact is their blocked -> queue operator path while attempt < max_attempts, owned by the exact blocked tail (terminal block or exact block-payload; a block-attempt-dir quarantine is permanently terminal for the task identity) and gated on byte-exact payload restoration. Exhausted work requires a new task_id.

runner_boundary.trusted_code: every manifest-listed Python module is reviewed trusted code and part of the TCB; payloads or hostile Python are never admitted to this manifest
runner_boundary.finder_guarantee: ordinary autonomy imports resolve only to bootstrap-verified in-memory bytes; an absent listed dependency fails closed with no ordinary filesystem fallback
runner_boundary.not_a_sandbox: the finder and scheduler AST closure are integrity/determinism controls and defence-in-depth lint, not a capability sandbox against Python already executing in-process
runner_boundary.handoff: the loader injects one fresh private one-shot object into runner; it detects accidental direct invocation/replay only and is not cryptographic provenance
runner_boundary.readiness_tick: the currently admitted supervisor_tick is a deterministic no-op and performs no queue, process, scheduler, network, SVN, or product mutation
runner_boundary.boot_clock: autonomy/boot_clock.py is a mandatory pinned dependency root and closure root: an absent or drifted entry fails validation closed before any Create or trusted runner execution. The module itself is a producer-only, UNINTEGRATED boot-clock component: WindowsBootClock().sample() pairs the raw 16-byte kernel boot-environment identifier (NtQuerySystemInformation class 90, accepted only on status 0 with ReturnLength 32, all-zero identifier refused, epoch = raw bytes hex, never a GUID rendering) with one time.monotonic_ns() observation bracketed by two identical identifier queries. Nothing in the autonomy runtime consumes a reading yet; a reading is NOT a cross-reboot ordering guarantee and grants NO live or deploy authority. The rejected clock-epoch integration architecture (seal_task, tick_core epoch propagation, scheduler epoch checks, residue policy) is deliberately not implemented. Non-win32 platforms fail closed before any WinDLL access; there is no cache, wall-clock, WMI, uptime, random, registry, environment or persisted-file fallback

enqueue_rules: card file must be an absolute existing path
payload is verified (containment + sha256) before the card enters queue/
task_id must not exist in any state directory and must have no leftover events/, attempts/, or exact/ marker residue
the queue card is published with exclusive no-overwrite create
